ROLE: 匹配主题对应的订阅会话并输出去重列表

SIGNATURE.RAW: bool mqtt_topic_tree_match_subscribers(const mqtt_topic_tree_t* t, const char* topic, int** out_sids, size_t* out_count)
SIGNATURE.NAME: mqtt_topic_tree_match_subscribers

FUNC.NAME: mqtt_topic_match
FUNC.ROLE: 判断过滤器是否匹配主题

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: mqtt_topic_tree_match_subscribers
CALL_CONTRACTS.SIGNATURE: bool mqtt_topic_tree_match_subscribers(const mqtt_topic_tree_t* t, const char* topic, int** out_sids, size_t* out_count)
PARAMS: t may be NULL only as invalid input
topic must be a non-NULL concrete publish topic, not a filter
out_sids must be non-NULL and is initialized to NULL before traversal
out_count must be non-NULL and is initialized to 0 before traversal
CALL_CONTRACTS.RETURN: true for completed matching including zero matches; false for invalid args or allocation failure
CALL_CONTRACTS.OWNERSHIP: on true with matches, *out_sids is heap-owned by caller and must be freed by caller

LOGIC.INPUT: 输入为主题树 t、主题 topic、输出数组 out_sids 与数量 out_count
LOGIC.ACTION: 先将输出置空；参数非法返回 false；遍历所有 filter，调用 mqtt_topic_match 判定命中；聚合 sid 并去重，按需扩容 uniq 数组；成功后写回输出
LOGIC.OUTPUT: 返回 true 表示匹配完成（含 0 命中），false 表示参数或内存失败
INVARIANTS_USED: 输出 sid 列表不包含重复值
内存扩容失败时会释放临时数组避免泄漏
